description: Synthetic proven-unique-parent-restore parity. Refusal messages come from the pinned blob. Candidate walks, fixture output, and planner results stay uncovered. No fixture diff is stored.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-proven-unique-parent-restore-affected-region: affected_region_proven_unique_parent_restore in the pin returns sesslint.policy.abstention.AffectedRegion. This set does not construct that region and does not cover a region row. tests/repair/test_scoped_abstention.py::test_region_functions_totality_fuzz is a multi-function sweep. One function inside the sweep is not the whole test.

GAP-proven-unique-parent-restore-candidates: once a parent id is ready, the pin calls find_qualifying_parent_candidates. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that refusal and does not replay a restored parent. tests/repair/test_recipes_conservative.py::test_parent_restore_refusal_zero_candidates, tests/repair/test_recipes_conservative.py::test_parent_restore_refusal_self_candidate, tests/repair/test_recipes_conservative.py::test_parent_restore_refusal_cross_branch, tests/repair/test_recipes_conservative.py::test_parent_restore_refusal_cross_segment, and tests/repair/test_recipes_conservative.py::test_parent_restore_excludes_successor_candidates are each one apply refusal after that call. tests/repair/test_recipes_conservative.py::test_proven_unique_parent_restore_fixture succeeds on the happy path and then refuses ambiguous candidates. A rust seam while the pin succeeds is not coverage. That success is not replayed. tests/checks/test_sl004_hardened.py::test_adversarial_decoy_prefix_collision, tests/checks/test_sl004_hardened.py::test_adversarial_decoy_cross_branch, tests/checks/test_sl004_hardened.py::test_adversarial_decoy_cross_segment, and tests/checks/test_sl004_hardened.py::test_adversarial_decoy_duplicate_candidates each run a detector, a plan, a precondition, and one apply. One apply inside that test is not the whole test. tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_forged_step_nonexistent_parent, tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_forged_step_prefix_collision, tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_forged_step_cross_branch_candidate, tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_forged_step_cross_segment_candidate, tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_forged_step_duplicate_candidate, tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_forged_step_self_reference, and tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_forged_step_post_child_candidate_causal_inversion each refuse after the parent id is ready. tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_events_mutated_in_memory_before_apply is three refusals. One refusal inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/checks/test_adversarial_confinement_challenge.py::TestCrossLayerCoercionAttacks::test_apply_refuses_cross_branch_tampered_step, test_apply_refuses_cross_segment_tampered_step, test_apply_refuses_prefix_tampered_step, and test_apply_refuses_ambiguous_tampered_step refuse after the parent id is ready. An integer parent id on the event is rendered and then that walk runs. The published function returns a different error.

GAP-proven-unique-parent-restore-canonical: planner.plan and execute are not run. A missing canonical codec call is not a successful plan. The fixture apply succeeds in the pin. That success is not replayed. tests/repair/test_recipes_conservative.py::test_plan_and_apply_parent_restore_full_flow plans and the apply succeeds. tests/repair/test_scoped_abstention.py::test_scenario_3_unknown_side_effects_on_relink_target plans and executes. tests/repair/test_scoped_abstention.py::test_parent_restore_disjoint_from_intermediate_mutating_tool plans and executes. tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_multiple_children_sharing_same_parent and tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_chained_missing_parents_handling plan and apply. The pin succeeds. A rust seam while the pin succeeds is not coverage. That success is not replayed. tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_forged_step_through_executor_lifecycle and tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_plan_tampered_detected plan and raise. tests/checks/test_adversarial_confinement_challenge.py::TestCrossLayerCoercionAttacks::test_e2e_executor_fails_closed_on_coercion_attempt executes. Those results are not replayed. No fingerprint is hashed and no fixture diff is stored. No output bytes are stored.

GAP-proven-unique-parent-restore-render: a float, list, or mapping parent id is rendered with str in the pin and then the candidate walk runs. The published function returns a different error. This set does not claim that pin result.

GAP-proven-unique-parent-restore-payload: tests/repair/test_recipes_conservative.py::test_proven_unique_parent_restore_fixture carries payload on the happy path and on the ambiguous refusal. This set does not store payload content. A payload-free result is not that test.

GAP-proven-unique-parent-restore-sweep: tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_forged_step_invalid_target_index checks several invalid indexes. One refusal inside a sweep is not the whole test. tests/test_challenger_stress.py::test_corrupted_params_variations is two missing-parent refusals. One refusal is not the whole test. tests/checks/test_adversarial_confinement_challenge.py::TestCrossLayerCoercionAttacks::test_apply_refuses_out_of_bounds_target_index checks several out-of-range indexes. One index inside a sweep is not the whole test. This set does not mark those tests covered.
